title: Guided Tour with drinks and tapas
text: My husband and I spent a lovely evening with Emilio eating and drinking, getting to experience the tapas culture of Granada.  Emilio was a fabulous host - knowledgeable about Granada, Spain and the food. We walked to five different establishments and tried the local ham, a dessert, nuts, a two other regional dishes. I would highly recommend this tour and Emilio as a guide.
author: 10Jenni10

title: Worth every minute
